description: Na₂VS₂O₉ crystallizes in the orthorhombic P2_12_12₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.97 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.92 Å. V is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted VO₆ octahedra that share corners with five SO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.64-2.16 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-47°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.52 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-54°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.51 Å. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na and one V atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one V and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na, one V, and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na, one V, and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one V, and one S atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one S atom.
